# Maptain

> XML sitemaps for Rails sites in many languages, rebuilt only where the content changed

Install with `gem "maptain"` in the Gemfile.

## Docs

- [Everything in one file](https://levups.github.io/maptain/llms-full.txt): the README, then every page below but the home page, in Markdown
- [Maptain: Rails sitemaps that rewrite only what changed](https://levups.github.io/maptain/): Maptain writes the XML sitemaps of a Rails site from its records, with the hreflang links of every language, and each build rewrites only the files whose records changed.
- [Maptain Guide](https://levups.github.io/maptain/guide.html): Install Maptain, describe your pages and their languages, build the sitemaps on a schedule, store them through Active Storage and submit changes to IndexNow.

## Optional

- [Maptain Benchmarks](https://levups.github.io/maptain/benchmarks.html): How long Maptain takes to build the sitemaps of 30,000 pages in 24 languages, to build them again when little or nothing changed, and how long sitemap_generator takes for the same.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/levups/maptain/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each version
- [Source code](https://github.com/levups/maptain)
